summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party remains the market's favourite. Much of the move came from [[South Carolina]], where the Democrat Annie Andrews gained a lot of ground, and [[Iowa]], where the Democrat Josh Turek also climbed sharply, with both seats now a predicted flip. The projected seat count recently changed to 56-44, up from 55-45, which means Democrats gain control, with [[Nebraska]] newly predicted as a flip.
summaries.governor: The Democrats Gina Hinojosa in [[Texas]] and Keisha Lance Bottoms in [[Georgia]] each gained ground sharply in Polymarket odds, and the market now treats both as predicted flips. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds also saw a sharp rise in the market's view of their chances.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning House control rising by a sizable amount, and they remain the favoured party. The market's projected seat count also moved to 254-181, up from 253-182, which would mean Democrats gain control, with [[KS-02 (Kansas City & Topeka)]], [[NJ-02 (Vineland & Atlantic City)]] and [[NY-21 (Rome & Plattsburgh)]] newly predicted flips.
